projection.name: Equirectangular with standard parallel 27 degrees north
projection.note: Uniform local geographic scale at 27N; north-south distances are not squeezed into a panorama. Longitude distortion varies modestly with latitude.

metadata.source_scale: 1:10,000,000 generalized cartography; 10m means ten million scale, not ten-meter accuracy
metadata.geometry_processing: Clipped to map bounds; no additional simplification; rounded to 6 decimal places. Land clipping connectors coincide with the frame.
metadata.boundary_note: Egypt outline is supplied by Natural Earth without alteration; political boundary representation is not a survey or an official legal determination.
metadata.coverage_note: Both Nile delta branches, Nile river plus Lake Nasser centerline, Suez and Ismailiya canals, and Lake Nasser are included. The source omits several smaller Egyptian lakes including Lake Qarun; no invented lake geometry is added.
